message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits are the law.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on most highways, 35 mph on city streets.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limits page | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is illegal.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | TxDOT – Cell Phone Use | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (0.02% BAC).
• Penalties: fines, license suspension, possible jail. | Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission (TABC) – DUI | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• “Right‑of‑way” rules for merging, turning, and intersections. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **School Bus** | • Stop for a school bus with its stop sign extended and lights flashing.
• Vehicles must stop on both sides of the road. | TxDOT – School Bus Rules | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals.
• Do not cut off other drivers.
• Keep a safe following distance. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Parking** | • No parking in front of driveways, fire hydrants, or on sidewalks.
• Pay for parking in designated areas. | TxDOT – Parking Regulations | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • All vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate.
• Most vehicles require an annual safety inspection. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **Towing & Tow‑away** | • Towing is allowed only for vehicles that are unsafe or obstructing traffic.
• Towing a vehicle without permission can lead to fines. | TxDOT – Towing Rules | | **Traffic Cameras & Speed Cameras** | • Cameras enforce speed limits and red‑light violations. | TxDOT – Traffic Enforcement | | **Emergency Vehicles** | • Yield to emergency vehicles with lights or sirens on. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Winter & Weather Conditions** | • Drivers must maintain control and adjust speed for weather.
• Use headlights in fog, rain, or snow. | TxDOT – Weather‑Related Driving | ### How to Stay Updated - **TxDOT Website** – Regular updates on traffic laws, road conditions, and safety campaigns. - **TxDMV** – For registration, licensing, and inspection requirements. - **Texas Transportation Code** – The official legal text; available online for detailed statutes. - **Local County Courts** – For specific local ordinances or recent changes. --- #### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas 1. **Always obey posted speed limits.** 2. **Keep a safe following distance** (at least 2–3 seconds). 3. **Use seat belts** and child restraints properly. 4. **Avoid distractions** – no handheld phone use. 5. **Yield to pedestrians** and school buses. 6. **Check for weather alerts** before traveling. If you need more detailed information on a specific law or have a particular scenario in mind, let me know!
